nameEn: Retail sale of books, newspapers and stationary in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of books, newspapers and stationery in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of books of all kinds
retail sale of newspapers and magazines
retail sale of stationery and office supplies: paper, pens, pencils
retail sale of school and office supplies
